title: Savanna Museum and Cultural Center

services.name: Historic Walking Tour
services.desc: A quiet cornerstone of downtown Savanna, the commercial building at 218 Main Street has stood proudly since 1898, bearing witness to more than a century of small-town evolution. While there isn’t detailed documentation about who first occupied 218 Main St, it's almost certainly part of that wave-likely launching as a retail storefront or office originally. Constructed during Savanna’s rail and river boom, the brick façade is emblematic of the city’s late-19th-century commercial growth, when Main Street thrived as a corridor of trade and opportunity.
